trigger: A supported six-visit ARKitScenes primary gate for the frozen nominee. B closed at its earlier development gate. No archive data, bridge, models or confirmation unless this gate is reached.
eligibility: One previously unused train scene for the bridge, then six previously unused test scenes from the scene-level v1 split. Sort scene then trajectory lexicographically. Use only released integer frame IDs and source file availability, finite proper poses, calibrated projective mapping and physical baselines before any held-out depth values are read. For increasing first frame ID, try exact ID strides 1,2,4,8 in that order. Require five unique IDs, each consecutive camera displacement >1e-6 m and endpoint displacement 0.05 through 0.75 m. No score or visibility selection. Exclude earlier project exposures in tracked result/manifest/docs at the recorded project commit; also exclude explicitly disclosed later exposures and all bridge scenes.
camera: Column-vector OpenGL-to-world orientations and asset-unit camera centres; transform x right, y up, z back via diag(1,-1,-1). Multiply centres (and bridge position labels) by meters_per_asset_unit. Derive rays from the scene M_cam_from_uv with pixel-centre coordinates u=2*(x+.5)/w-1, v=1-2*(y+.5)/h. Cross-check independently against M_proj to 0.002 pixel. Keep projective tilt when rectifying onto a 518-wide square-pixel-grid raster with height rounded to the closest multiple of 14, and pinhole focal lengths from the optical-axis derivative (retain separate fx/fy). Increase focal lengths by 1.01^n for smallest n in 0..70 that leaves every output pixel within source. Unusable forward calibrations are geometry exclusions.
surface: Use publisher tonemap.jpg eight-bit RGB with explicit bilinear pullback at rectified ray pixel centres. For the reference, round each native pixel coordinate to nearest (half-up), derive the unit source ray, multiply it by the Euclidean range in metres, retain finite points with axial Z in [0.2,10] m. Do not interpolate across depth edges. Only RGB, calibrated K and world-to-camera extrinsics enter the model packet. Training bridge alone reads world-position HDF5.
bridge: Each of the five predetermined training frames must have >=1000 matching position samples and >=99% finite position labels over eligible ray support. Record raw deviations and median/p95 after subtracting a full last-place unit of each released FP16 annotation (3-D position in metres and radial range). Corrected median <=2 mm and p95 <=10 mm. Independently reproject official world positions to native pixels: median <=0.5 px, p95 <=2 px. Failure on this fixed Training window ends replication; never replace the bridge after observing a geometric residual.
resources: Require HTTP 206 exact ranges, matching ETag, ZIP CRC32 and content SHA-256. 32 MiB maximum per compressed request and 350 MiB cumulative payload in a single scene operation. Never silently download a whole 1–20 GB archive. Preserve evidenced HTTP/CRC or loader failures separately from scientific failure.
outcome: Lock both bridge and replication inputs before their respective geometry stages. Researchers publish compact manifests/digests only. Use exactly the nominee, seeds, controls, failure denominators, surface scorer and bounds from primary. USD 0 RunPod.
